comments.author: Such-Pen-5865
comments.body:
I've been working on this app for about 4 months now using AI tools and my computer engineering background. Its pretty cool to see how far the app has come! I just launched it on the app store and would love for you guys to check it out and let me know any feedback. It has a nautical based storyline, progression, upgrades, and more. There are multiple games modes yahtzee, vs the captain (AI), 6 dice, triple yahtzee and farkle (coming soon!).

It's super tough to get noticed on the app store, so finding organic players who actually care means a lot to me. If you could take a look, that would be awesome! :) [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/yacht-zee-dice-games-adventure/id6748318454](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/yacht-zee-dice-games-adventure/id6748318454)

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: Congrats on the launch! It’s awesome to hear how you combined AI tools with your computer engineering background to build this over the past few months. Is there an Android version or plans for one? I’m using an Android phone, so I’d love to check it out once it’s available. This feels like the kind of project that would also fit well on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com), where people love seeing creative indie builds. They also give detailed feedback and suggestion there.
